pages.text: Bind this primer with $(item)Leather$() and three $(item)Empty Pages$(). If the old library spirits answer, a right-click shall open these notes. If they do not, the book remains as a token for stewards of realms to place in worthy hands.

The craft begins with five humble instruments: $(item)Empty Pages$(), $(item)Symbol Pages$(), $(item)Descriptive Books$(), $(item)Linking Books$(), and the $(thing)Book Binder$(). The binder is the desk at which a world first hears its name.

The path is simple to speak and perilous to walk: gather pages, bind a descriptive book, name the Age before its first opening, then step through. Careful writing steadies the road. Empty boasts and contradictions teach the road to shake.
